name: arc-editor
description: POC: standalone Monaco-based ARC editor that shares the MyContexts SharedWorker/PDR.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter perspectives-proxy run build && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:into-mycontexts: pnpm run build && rm -rf ../mycontexts/dist/arceditor && cp -r dist ../mycontexts/dist/arceditor
